title: P1 enqueue request
description: P1 enqueue request: the task body and the request fields the sender may pass. The request has no task record fields (tenant, initiator, origin, max_tier, data_mark, untrusted_seen, approval_id and others) and no "this worker" field: the schema rejects a request with such a field (IDN-1, DSP-4, TEN-2). Only the core sets a key with the prefix system:, so the schema rejects a sender request with such a key (IDM-1, IDM-2). The type action.* is not accepted in enqueue (APR-5): this is a core check by type name. A denial at enqueue does not take the key.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key, unique in the pair (tenant, idempotency_key). A repeat with the same key, the same initiator and the same body returns the existing task; otherwise idempotency_conflict. The prefix system: is only for the core.

refs.description: References to past tasks, files and campaigns; only objects of one's own tenant that the initiator created or that came from the origin chat, otherwise rejected(ref_invalid) (TEN-7).

priority.description: Priority class; a request can only lower the type's class (dispatch.priority_class, 3-5). Classes 1 and 2 are set only by the core (DSP-5).

to.description: Bot group address. It only narrows dispatch: only a member of the group gets the task (D5). Another tenant's, a nonexistent and a disallowed group all get the same rejected(group_invalid) (DSP-4).

scope.description: Narrowing of the resource scope for a child: ids of resources in the tenant catalog; only a narrowing of the parent's scope.

mode.description: Since v0.2: validate checks the body and permissions without enqueuing: no task, no idempotency key, no budget reserve, only an audit line with the dry_run flag (PRM-11).
